headline: Honest, fast negative on the committee's L7 design, but it is an operator artifact. The mca-MIRd 'whole-cell' flip picked uniformly among A0>0.3 components, so 13/18 events hit 1-19 px halo dots, and the 4 real mutants flipped only ~30-50% of the body, which the cell's own periphery rebuilt. Full-body flips persisted in 4/4 skeptic branches. L7 is Not tested, the mcg continuous-trait work is L7 Weak, and the rung is unchanged at L6[L2]+L4c+L5 (and r-two56 L3).
message_to_researcher:
Decision: CONTINUE, with a corrected operator, a time box and a stop rule (promise 5/10). No rung moved: L6[L2]+L4c+L5 (mcfd-MIRd) and L3 (r-two56) stand from r1.

What convinced us:
- You built the L7 design fast, paired S/N through one RNG, matched the ancestor, and reported the negative straight.
- "Selection needs turnover; a confluent Lenia tissue shuts it off" (H3 vs H4) is a real law.
- mcg-MIRd: L6[L2] Supported, medium confidence.

What did not:
- **mca-MIRd L7 is Not tested, not Contradicted.**
  - Your operator labels A0>0.3 components with no size filter, so 13/18 events flipped 1-19 px halo dots.
  - Only 4 independent mutants hit a cell, each flipping ~30-50% of its matter.
  - Skeptic branches (seed 11, mutation off): a 29% flip eroded 0.037->0.006 in 80 t from the cell's own periphery; whole-body flips persisted 4/4, one 1->2 division bred true.
  - Our r1 wording ("a connected A0 component") invited this.
- **2932/2933 true divisions is null** in a majority-rule monoculture. Purity on the mutation mask cannot see a carrier eroding while alive.
- **mcg purifying: L7 Weak.** 29/34 harmful neutral samples come from one seed; 2/3 neutral g curves overlap selection; blurred trait; no ledger.
- **Competition: Weak.** The kinds were planted.
- **Two-sided yield: L7 Contradicted** (no g difference). The lattice tipping stays Weak until a Jensen control: variance in e^g raises mean yield. Drop [L3?].

Main experiment (first half of the sprint):
1. Targets: A0-core territories >=100 px within M>~0.03 (watershed). Flip the whole territory in all channels, dilated 2 px. Log flipped-mass fraction per event; require >=0.9.
2. Take >=12 branch points from N-arm runs (192², decay 0.03), each a mature, isolated cell. From each identical state run old operator vs whole-body flip, each under S (EFF 0.15) and N, mutation off, >=500 t.
3. Readouts every 5 t on whole-body masks: carrier purity, death or division, each daughter's allele, and allele-1 lineage size vs N-arm drift (~1/N). Ship a pack with allele colour in the sheet.

Pass (>=90% true allele-1 divisions, old operator erodes): rerun the committee S/N test with the fixed operator, >=5 seeds/arm, per-kind ledger.
Fail in both arms: report the law, try per-body confinement once, then stop L7 on MIRd+.

Secondary goals:
1. r-two56 on build-from-food plus decay, mu in {0.01, 0.03}, from noise, 3 seeds, per-channel radial. At least 1/3 of the sprint.
2. Jensen control: keep the variance in g, remove heredity.
3. One dt/2 run and one 256² run of the mca N arm.

Stop: mcg L7 runs, H8-H10, cycle sweeps.

Borrow:
- autopoiesis kindtrack.py and the co-mutated neutral tag (origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/kindtrack.py, worlds/motile_trait/world.py);
- chemotaxis-motility fission.py (origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/fission.py);
- active-droplets ad7t-thick (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/packs/ad7t-thick).

leaderboard_rows.note: The committee's discrete-allele L7 test: majority inheritance, S EFF=0.15 vs an identical-event N arm, 3+3 seeds, 192², 20000 steps. L7 Not tested. The operator picks uniformly among A0>0.3 components, so 13/18 events flipped 1-19 px halo dots. The 4 independent cell-scale events (step 507 is shared by S_0 and N_0) flipped only the A0 core + 4 px, ~30-50% of the body's matter. All were lost in 50-150 t in both arms; the 507 event was lost identically in S and N during growth. Skeptic branches from one seed-11 state: a 29% flip erodes 0.037->0.006 in 80 t, while whole-body flips persist 4/4 (one 1->2 division, both daughters allele 1). 'Resident heredity 2932/2933' is null by construction. L6 is inherited from mcfd-MIRd; the skeptic's labkit rerun gives gen 2 and 5 persistent splits by t=150. No pack or sheet.

Continuous yield trait g carried by matter (3-px blur inheritance), with one-sided harmful mutations, 3+3 seeds at 160². The planted MIRd+ booms to ~30 cells, crashes to 3-4 (t~436-522) and regrows by fission (sheet). labkit reads gen 0, and merges are 74% of splits. L7 Weak: harmful cell-samples 1/256 vs 34/237, but 29 of the 34 come from one neutral seed, 2 of 3 neutral mean-g curves overlap selection, the fitness effect is designed, the trait blends at contacts, and there is no ledger. Competition assay (planted g=0 vs -0.3, 128²): L7 Weak; one neutral seed loses the low kind as fast as selection. Two-sided yield: 3/3 selection runs freeze into a fed lattice vs 3/3 neutral runs cycling, with no mean-g difference. L7 Contradicted; the eco-evolutionary shift is Weak (Jensen: variance in e^g raises mean yield; no non-heritable control). L3 Weak (1-2 px halo dots), so the [L3?] is dropped.

cross_pollination.suggestion: Mutation coverage law from lenia-multichannel r2. The 'whole-cell' flip in mca-MIRd chose uniformly among A0>0.3 components, so 13/18 events hit 1-19 px halo dots, and core hits flipped only ~30-50% of the body's matter. Under majority rebuilding, a 29%-coverage mutant was reconverted by its own unflipped periphery (allele share 0.037->0.006 in 80 t), while whole-body flips of the same cells persisted in 4/4 branches (committee/reviews/lenia-multichannel_r2.md; judge-scratch/lenia-multichannel-r2-skeptic/flip/). ad5's 5-px half-droplet transplant is in this regime. Log the flipped-mass fraction of the target droplet per event, and choose targets among individuals above a size cut (origin/claude/alife-lenia-multichannel:research/alife/threads/lenia-multichannel/worlds/mca-MIRd/world.py).

Your kick-arisen markers bred true 0/3 (on->on+off, by polar segregation of a fresh kick). lenia-multichannel r2 found the same law under majority inheritance with full matter turnover: a mutant covering ~30-50% of a body is reconverted by the body's own unflipped matter, while whole-body flips persist (4/4 judge branches; committee/reviews/lenia-multichannel_r2.md). Log each kick's coverage of the target cell's material, and run one whole-cell kick arm before tuning the division rate (origin/claude/alife-lenia-multichannel:research/alife/threads/lenia-multichannel/screen_data/mca/*.json, worlds/mca-MIRd/world.py).

Audit lesson from lenia-multichannel r2. mca-MIRd measured purity on the same mask as the mutation (A0 + 3 px), so a carrier eroding back to the resident allele while alive never counted as a conversion. Its '2932/2933 true divisions' were resident-allele divisions in a majority-rule monoculture, which is null by construction. For arm E, measure purity over the whole-body footprint and report minority-kind divisions separately from resident ones (origin/claude/alife-lenia-multichannel:research/alife/threads/lenia-multichannel/tools/audit_alleles.py, screen_data/mca/*.json).

Jensen control for convex traits. In lenia-multichannel's two-sided yield runs (yield Y*e^g), 3/3 selection runs froze into a fed static lattice and 3/3 neutral runs kept cycling, yet mean g did not differ between arms (origin/claude/alife-lenia-multichannel:research/alife/threads/lenia-multichannel/screens/mcg_yield_selection_vs_neutral.png). Mutational variance in a convex trait raises mean performance with no selection at all. If the fl_forager_gene uptake gene enters uptake multiplicatively or exponentially, add a non-heritable variance control next to the neutral twin. Also check whether S and N end in different ecological states (turnover vs lattice): in lenia-multichannel, selection acted only while turnover lasted (H3 vs H4).

From autopoiesis: kindtrack.py counts conversions of intact cells, per-kind births and deaths, and first-acquisition events. A co-mutated neutral tag in the same bodies gives an in-run drift control, which matters with 5-35 cells (origin/claude/alife-autopoiesis:research/alife/threads/autopoiesis/kindtrack.py, worlds/motile_trait/world.py). From chemotaxis-motility: fission.py is a dense tracker in which both daughters must survive >=40 t and generation follows the largest parent. Use it for per-daughter allele readouts, since labkit reads gen 0 on MIRd+ (origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/fission.py).

If whole-body mutants breed true but drift still swamps a 15% yield effect in 5-35-cell populations, borrow two designs. (1) chemotaxis-motility evopursuit's partner-driven selective window: a consumer that pushes the ancestor toward collapse gave 3/3 sweeps vs 0/3 and 0/3 (origin/claude/alife-chemotaxis-motility:research/alife/threads/chemotaxis-motility/packs/evopursuit_cost22, evopursuit_cost30_s0). (2) A trait with an interior optimum, which you predicted would avoid the lattice tipping. active-droplets ad7t-thick evolves toward such an optimum from both sides against neutral controls, with dilution 0.002 removing non-dividers (origin/claude/alife-active-droplets:research/alife/threads/active-droplets/REPORT_r2.md, packs/ad7t-thick/alleles.png). In flow-lenia r2, only genes acting on the birth-death balance were selected (origin/claude/alife-flow-lenia:research/alife/threads/flow-lenia/REPORT_r2.md, evo2/gene_all.png).

rubric_issues: L7 mutation operators: require a per-event log of the flipped-mass fraction of the targeted individual, summed over all material channels, with >=0.9 for a 'whole-cell' mutation. Choose targets among individuals, not raw thresholded components, which include debris. The committee's own r1 wording ('flip one whole cell (a connected A0 component)') was mis-specified for multi-channel bodies, where A0 is only the core (~1/3 of MIRd+ matter).

L7 heredity counts: report true divisions per kind. Resident-kind true divisions in a majority-rule monoculture are a null test and must not be presented as heredity. Measure purity and conversions over the whole-body footprint, never over the mutation mask.

Convex traits: when a trait enters fitness convexly (yield Y*e^g), mutational variance alone shifts mean physiology. An S/N contrast in ecology (e.g. lattice vs cycle) needs a non-heritable variance control before it is attributed to selection.

labkit (repeated from r1, still unfixed): lineage reads gen 0 and 0 persistent splits in all 6 mcg packs despite visible fission, because K = 10% of the run. Sheets have no kind/trait colour layer: g+ is drawn yellow on a yellow cap, so it is invisible. No per-channel radial.png is produced for multi-channel creatures.
